episodes.synopsis: La dipendente oberata di lavoro Oohashi Rei si ritrova improvvisamente nel mondo del suo gioco otome preferito nei panni della protagonista, Rae Taylor. Ma non è qui per innamorarsi dei protagonisti maschili del gioco: è innamorata dellla cattiva!
episodes.title: La mia vita nell'altro mondo è turbolenta

episodes.synopsis: Rae punta sul lavoro dei suoi sogni,  ovvero entrare a far parte della servitù di Claire, e farà di tutto per ottenerlo.
episodes.title: Il lavoro di cameriera è un servizio d'amore

episodes.synopsis: Rendendosi conto che Claire è innamorata di Thane, Rae  conoscendo gli eventi del gioco, cerca di far unire Thane e Claire, nonostante i suoi sentimenti per Claire.
episodes.title: Il mio amore si rialza dopo ogni batosta

episodes.synopsis: Rae impressiona la sua insegnante e i suoi compagni di classe all'accademia con la sua competenza nella magia... ed è presto costretta a mettere in pratica le sue abilità quando un enorme mostro attacca.
episodes.title: Non essere pronti a un attacco dei mostri può rivelarsi fatale

episodes.synopsis: Rae e Claire superano entrambi l'esame scritto per l'ingresso nell'Academia dei Cavalieri. Il passo successivo è l'esame pratico, che mette gli esaminandi l'uno contro l'altro in finte battaglie per determinare chi è veramente degno di unirsi ai Cavalieri.
episodes.title: L'esame dell'Ordine è una tragicommedia

episodes.synopsis: Si avvicina la Fiera del Giorno della Fondazione e i Cavalieri dell'Accademia discutono sul tipo di negozio che dovrebbero aprire. Un commento disinvolto di Rae porta alla proposta di un cafè bar a ruoli invertiti.
episodes.title: La ragione segreta deve restare segretissima

episodes.synopsis: Rae sfrutta al massimo la Fiera del Giorno della Fondazione, lavorando sodo al bar cfé dei ruoli invertiti e convincendo persino Claire a fare un giro per la fiera con lei. Ma un incidente con un gruppo di popolani amareggiati getta un'ombra sul clima di festa.
episodes.title: L'asso nella manica per il festival è il café a ruoli invertiti

episodes.synopsis: L'Accademia Reale è scossa dallo scandalo quando uno studente nobile presumibilmente attacca uno studente plebeo con la magia. La situazione peggiora quando l'aggressore riceve una punizione minima, spingendo i cittadini comuni a protestare così violentemente che la scuola deve essere chiusa.
episodes.title: Le impetuose correnti sono una trappola machiavellica

episodes.synopsis: Quando dietro la rivolta popolare viene svelato un complotto oscuro, l'accademia si trova in pericolo. Riusciranno Rae e Claire a sconfiggere i cospiratori e ad affrontare le conseguenze che ne derivano?
episodes.title: La mia fedeltà è eterna e infinita

episodes.synopsis: La Principessa Manaria del Regno di Sousse, una vecchia amica d'infanzia di Claire, si presenta a farle visita. Manaria ha tutto: bell'aspetto, carisma, straordinaria abilità magica e, per finire, Claire è piuttosto presa da lei. Sembra che Rae abbia un nuovo rivale.
episodes.title: La mia nuova rivale in amore è semplicemente troppo perfetta

episodes.synopsis: Rae insiste che vuole solo che Claire sia felice, anche se non può stare con lei. Manaria le dice che sta semplicemente scappando, e se i suoi sentimenti per Claire sono veri, combatterà per lei. Inizia così il loro duello per determinare chi resterà al fianco di Claire.
episodes.title: Una disputa amorosa è una trappola senza uscita

episodes.synopsis: Manaria challenges Rae to prove her feelings for Claire at the Amour Ceremony. Both Rae and Manaria must place an item on the Scales of Love, which will measure the weight of their feelings for Claire. Who will the scales find worthy?
episodes.title: Io e il mio personaggio preferito ci amiamo

info.synopsis: La normale impiegata Oohashi Rei si sveglia nel corpo della protagonista del suo gioco otome preferito, Revolution. Per la sua gioia, la prima persona che incontra è anche il suo personaggio preferito, Claire François, l’antagonista principale della storia! Ora Rei è determinata a perseguire una storia d’amore con Claire piuttosto che con gli interessi amorosi maschili. Ma come reagirà la sua amata antagonista a questo nuovo corteggiamento?!
info.title: I'm in Love with the Villainess (ITA)

episodes.synopsis: One day, a youth named Akina Myodo from Kanazawa of Kaga obtains a mysterious card after experiencing a vision of planet Cray. That card is proof that he has been chosen as the Fated One of Miracles, and an invitation to the "Fated Clash", where the last one standing can have their wish granted.
episodes.title: Fated One of Miracles

episodes.synopsis: With the knowledge that Hikari's illness may be cured if he is the last one standing in the "Fated Clash", Akina gains a sense for Vanguard under the tutelage of Nao, his senior from his part-time job. However, as if his line of thinking was foreseen, Gabwelius appears before Akina once more.
episodes.title: Fated Clash

episodes.synopsis: First round of the Fated Clash is set at the spiritual ground, Hakusan. The Fated Ones facing off are Unparalleled vs. Miracles. A sudden match between the apprentice and the master, Akina and Nao. Nao exhibits unparalleled strength, aiming to be a pro-fighter. Does Akina stand a chance?
episodes.title: Unparalleled and Miracles

episodes.synopsis: The perfect idol Mikoto is currently on hiatus and hooked on Net Vanguard. Joining an offline meeting, Akina witnesses the fight between Megumi and Mikoto. Meanwhile, the masked person comes into contact with Suo Yobitsugi.
episodes.title: An Idol`s Afternoon

episodes.synopsis: It's the second round of the Fated Clash, and for some reason, Mikoto's opponent Taizo Kiyokura knows about Akina, and even visits Hikari in hospital. The fight begins, and while Taizo praises Mikoto's effort, he also remarks that he "can't see her self in her fights".
episodes.title: The Guiding Star of Ever-changing

episodes.synopsis: Akina faces off against Taizo in the third round of the Fated Clash. Taizo's confidence remains unshaken despite his consecutive battles, as giving his best at all times is his style as a pro-fighter. Recognizing the difference in skill, Akina bets on the "one in a hundred" chance and fights with all his might.
episodes.title: Reckless Wings

episodes.synopsis: The quiet and emotionless boy Suo Yobitsugi shares with Akina about his painful past as the pair pass a stormy night in town. Meanwhile, as Masanori starts questioning Gabwelius about the true aim of the Fated Clash, Shinobu appears to challenge him to a showdown.
episodes.title: Towards the Stormy Day

episodes.synopsis: Nao participates in the "Rising Dragon Cup" Vanguard tournament. Her opponent Mondo Kirishima is a powerful pro-fighter who made a comeback to show his son how fights should be done, but Nao is giving it her all as well. Who will emerge victorious?!
episodes.title: Maiden`s Reverie

episodes.synopsis: It is the third round of the Fated Clash, with Suo standing on the Hakusan stage. Masanori attempts to bewilder his opponent, but Suo remains unfazed. An unexpected development occurs in the fight between Zero and Taboo. What exactly does Suo desire from the Fated Clash?
episodes.title: Taboo Upon Zero

episodes.synopsis: The shocking revelation of the true identity of the masked person. The reason for her various actions in the Fated Clash, as well as the mystery of the supposedly nonexistent "Seventh Fated One," are now unveiled. If the final clash were to take place, all that awaits is destruction. What decision will Akina make with this knowledge?
episodes.title: The Seventh Wish

episodes.synopsis: Will it be Akina or Hikari who changes fate? Their resolves clash right before the final showdown. With Gabwelius watching as the one who created what started everything, Hikari's "Fated One of Time, Liael=Amorta" finally appears. Which of them will win and change the future!
episodes.title: Siblings

episodes.synopsis: It's the final battle of the Fated Clash. If Akina wins, Hikari's illness will be cured, and Suo will be saved from the void. Akina is determined to change the future. With the owners of the Fated Ones looking on, the last fight between the fate of Miracles and Zero begins!
episodes.title: The Fated Moment

episodes.synopsis: Right as it seems that everything will return to Zero, the seventh Fated One's card that Hikari brought saves Akina from his pinch! "Even though it's just a glimmer of hope, a miracle will descend upon those who reach out their hand". Can the future actually be changed!?
episodes.title: A Sliver of Light

episodes.synopsis: Ufficialmente fidanzato con Sylphie, Rudeus si mette a cercare una casa in cui iniziare la vita a due. La scelta cade su una villa che nessuno vuole per via delle voci che la circondano, e sistemarla si rivela un'impresa più complicata del previsto.
episodes.title: La casetta dei miei sogni

episodes.synopsis: Rudeus e Sylphie organizzano nella nuova casa una festa per celebrare il matrimonio, invitando amici e conoscenti dell'Accademia. Tra i preparativi e gli ospiti, la giornata diventa l'occasione per capire quante persone si siano ormai legate a loro.
episodes.title: Celebrazione

episodes.synopsis: Arriva una lettera di Paul: dopo anni di ricerche, si sono finalmente trovate tracce di Zenith. Nello stesso periodo Rudeus riceve un'altra notizia da casa, perché Aisha e Norn stanno per raggiungerlo a Ranoa, e la quiete della sua nuova vita è destinata a durare poco.
episodes.title: Distanza

episodes.synopsis: Le due sorelle arrivano da Rudeus con stati d'animo opposti: Aisha è entusiasta all'idea di vivere con il fratello maggiore, mentre Norn mal sopporta di essere stata allontanata dal padre e non fa nulla per nasconderlo.
episodes.title: Norn e Aisha

episodes.synopsis: Il rapporto con Norn continua a deteriorarsi, e Rudeus si rende conto di stare ripetendo errori che riconosce fin troppo bene dalla vita precedente. Per non perdere anche questa occasione, decide di provare a capire davvero che cosa stia passando la sorella.
episodes.title: I sentimenti di un fratello maggiore

episodes.synopsis: Il dio-uomo torna a comparire in sogno e annuncia a Rudeus quali saranno i prossimi eventi, indicandogli esattamente come dovrebbe comportarsi. Questa volta, però, Rudeus ha imparato qualcosa sul conto di quella voce, e non è affatto disposto a seguirla.
episodes.title: Punto di svolta n°3

episodes.synopsis: Rudeus parte insieme a Elinalise per raggiungere il padre e unirsi alle ricerche di Zenith. Il cammino attraversa un deserto ostile che li separa dalla città di Rapan, e lungo la strada emergono verità scomode sul passato della sua compagna di viaggio.
episodes.title: Il viaggio nel deserto

episodes.synopsis: A Rapan, Rudeus ritrova Geese e finalmente Paul, insieme alla squadra che da tempo esplora il labirinto in cui si troverebbe Zenith. La notizia che lo accoglie è però pessima: Roxy è entrata nel dungeon e non è più tornata.
episodes.title: Ingresso nel labirinto

episodes.synopsis: Rudeus riesce a raggiungere Roxy e a strapparla a un'orda di mostri, ma la donna non sembra rendersi conto di chi abbia davanti. Ricomposto il gruppo, la squadra si prepara a scendere di nuovo nel labirinto, consapevole che stavolta non ci sarà spazio per errori.
episodes.title: Il cerchio magico del sesto livello

episodes.synopsis: Nelle profondità del labirinto il gruppo trova finalmente Zenith, ma a vegliare su di lei c'è una creatura enorme che non ha alcuna intenzione di lasciarla andare. Rudeus e Paul si mettono in prima linea per affrontarla, padre e figlio fianco a fianco per la prima volta.
episodes.title: Genitori

episodes.synopsis: Il prezzo pagato nel labirinto lascia Rudeus incapace di reagire. A rimetterlo in piedi è Roxy, e ciò che accade tra loro lo porterà a rimettere in discussione alcune delle scelte che credeva già fatte.
episodes.title: Torniamo a casa

episodes.synopsis: Rudeus fa ritorno a casa portando con sé notizie buone e notizie che avrebbe voluto non dover dare. A Sylphie rivolge poi una richiesta tutt'altro che semplice, che riguarda il futuro della loro famiglia e ciò che ha deciso di farsene dell'eredità ricevuta.
episodes.title: Eredità

episodes.synopsis: Una volta riuniti tutti i candidati selezionati, ha inizio il secondo test. Tuttavia, il responsabile fa una proposta particolare a Viole, che ha superato il test col punteggio massimo.

episodes.synopsis: Viole si rifiuta di scegliere dei compagni per proseguire il viaggio. Quindi, viene svolto un altro test per risolvere il problema.

episodes.synopsis: Nel test del 20° piano, i candidati devono creare dei team e prendere il controllo delle stanze, Tuttavia, la fiducia è rara in un mondo che premia i tradimenti.

episodes.synopsis: Khun continua a salire sulla torre. Ha formato un nuovo team e porta con sé Rachel, ormai invalida. Ma c'è molto altro dietro...

episodes.synopsis: Il team con Viole e Wangnan deve affrontare il test successivo, per poter continuare a salire sulla torre. Ma, prima di questo, i vari membri del team sono esaminati dai compagni di Viole del FUG.
episodes.title: Il fiore di Zigena

episodes.synopsis: La battaglia tra Urek e Viole continua all'interno dello Zygena e la posta in gioco è il fiore di Zygena. Però lo scontro prende una piega inaspettata...

episodes.synopsis: Sia il team di Khun che quello di Wangnan e Viole continuano a salire sulla torre, affrontando le avversità che si presentano loro davanti. Nel mentre, scoprono un nuovo strumento, un chat bot sempre più popolare, Emily.
episodes.title: Il suo nome è Emily

episodes.synopsis: Kang Horyang racconta il suo passato al resto del gruppo e chiede a Viole da dove venga il suo potere.
episodes.title: Il diavolo con un'ala sola

episodes.synopsis: Kang Horyang va da solo a cercare Cassano. Incapaci di abbandonare il proprio compagno, Viole e gli altri decidono di seguirlo.
episodes.title: La Mano di Arlen

episodes.synopsis: Viole è testimone della sconfitta di Kang Horyang e libera un incredibile potere. Nel frattempo, Khun capisce di essere stato tradito e corre a salvare i suoi compagni.
episodes.title: Un muro spesso e distante

episodes.synopsis: Wangnan e i suoi compagni arrivano alla Mano di Arlen, ma si trovano davanti nient'altro che macerie. Dopo una lunga ricerca, recuperano Khun dalle macerie...
episodes.title: Una nuova prova

episodes.synopsis: Khun learns the truth from Hwaryun and decides to join Wangnan's team in the Workshop Battle. Meanwhile, Bam remains on Team FUG as Viole.

episodes.synopsis: L'incontro con il viaggiatore
episodes.title: L'incontro con il viaggiatore

episodes.synopsis: Unaware that FUG agent Viole is actually Bam, Endorsi Jahad attempts to capture him. Meanwhile, Team Shibisu launches a surprise attack on the hotel where Team FUG is staying and Wangnan and Team Khun face off against Chang and Quaetro.
episodes.title: La promessa di quel giorno

episodes.synopsis: Shibisu e i suoi compagni attaccano l'hotel dove alloggiano i membri del FUG. Jue Viole Grace li affronta per evitare una catastrofe.

episodes.synopsis: I partecipanti che sono entrati in possesso di una carta d'imbarco si godono un momento di riposo a bordo dell'Archimedes, prima dell'inizio del torneo. C'è ancora molto da chiarire...
episodes.title: Funky!

episodes.synopsis: Wangnan, Prince e Akraptor si trovano costretti a combattere contro Miseng, che è sotto l'effetto dell'abilità di Verdi. Come faranno a fermare la sua furia, visto che non ci possono parlare?

episodes.synopsis: Allo scontro tra Anaak e Ran vengono applicate regole speciali e i due si trovano a duellare l'una contro l'altro, in uno scontro senza esclusione di colpi. Nel frattempo, Beta va a trovare Viole...
episodes.title: ALL IN

episodes.synopsis: Le otto squadre perdenti devono prendere parte al Torneo di sviluppo. Il vincitore di questo torneo affronterà il vincitore dello scontro tra team FUG e team Cani Rabbiosi per aggiudicarsi il primo premio.
episodes.title: Sul filo del rasoio

episodes.synopsis: Viole è stato catturato da Beta e scopre quale sarà il suo destino. Nel frattempo, Shibusu e Khun si incontrano di nuovo e cercano un modo per salvare Bam...
episodes.title: L'inizio dell'alba

episodes.synopsis: Iniziano le semifinali! La squadra di Khun e Wangnan punta a richiamare Viole sul campo di battaglia. Ma per poterlo fare, Viole dovrà prima essere liberato...
episodes.title: I due dell'Officina

episodes.synopsis: Il team Khun cerca di richiamare Viole sfruttando il negozio di oggetti e riunirsi così col loro vecchio amico. Ma Beta entra in scena e accoltella Wangnan proprio mentre inizia l'evocazione...
episodes.title: La fine dell'alba

episodes.synopsis: Viole è stato richiamato e finalmente incontra i suoi vecchi compagni. Ma la battaglia non si è ancora conclusa...
episodes.title: Il prezzo della guerra

episodes.synopsis: While Reflejo, Viole (Bam), Khun, and Rak are engaged in their final showdown, FUG and the Workshop attempt to pour a solution capable of melting everything into the area... Lero Ro and Endorsi rush to their three companions in order to save them, but FUG Rankers and Team Mad Dog stand in their way! Will Viole and the others be able to escape safely?!
episodes.title: Return of the King

episodes.synopsis: La Battaglia dell'Officina è terminata, ma Viole e i suoi amici non sono ancora al sicuro. Madoraco ha mandato i suoi uomini a cercare lui e la Spina. Quant e Lero Ro riusciranno a permettere al gruppo di fuggire?
episodes.title: L'alba della partenza

episodes.synopsis: It's 30 December 1999. Utsumi and Bud have returned to Japan to challenge the SV2 again, and sell their team's services in the format of the Griffin. At the SV2, the AV-Zero is going though its paces. It has been improved and is now much faster. Kanuka has returned to Japan to visit her grandmother and has dropped by to visit her former colleagues at the SV2. Detective Matsui discovers that several top Labor specialists are in town and informs Captain Goto of his findings. Meanwhile, Momoko Sakurayama receives a tip-off that several arms dealers are also in Tokyo. She informs Kumagami, who in turn tells Captain Goto. Something big is going to happen. That night the Griffin Labor returns. Division 2 was previously called out to a fire, so Division 1 is called in to deal with the Labor. Bud soon figures out the Zero's weakness: it is programmed to stop near buildings to avoid damage. He takes full advantage of this and defeats both Patlabors.
episodes.title: Griffon Resurrected

episodes.synopsis: The remains of Division 1's Labors return to the hanger. Noa is somewhat scared of the prospect of having to fight the Griffin again, but Asuma assures her that she can defeat it. Meanwhile Schaft's section chief is livid at Utsumi's actions. Goto asks Kumagami about her relationship with Utsumi. She tells him it is none of his business. Bud leaves the ship where the Griffin is being hidden to visit the SV2.
episodes.title: A Miserable Day

episodes.synopsis: The Griffin is ready to fight Division 2. Momoko Sakurayama races to the scene, but a traffic jam is holding them up. She decides she can wait no longer, and runs to the scene without her camera crew. Meanwhile, the Ingrams face off the Griffin across a bridge. In the ensuing battle, the Griffin escapes off the bridge into the water and Ota shoots a hole into the bridge with the shotgun in an attempt to hit it. But the Griffin pulls Ota's Labor down through the hole. Ota manages to escape, but his Labor is at the bottom of the bay.
episodes.title: SCHAFT`s Counterattack

episodes.synopsis: Noa isn't moving, so Hiromi moves his carrier back, out of reach of the Griffin. Meanwhile Shinshi rams the Griffin with his carrier to enable Hiromi and Noa to escape. Noa's Labor is now totally out of power. She needs to recharge her batteries fast. Unfortunately, the Griffin has gotten past Shinshi, who tries to block it, but feels the Griffin's wrath for his trouble. The Griffin runs after the escaping carrier, but Kanuka arrives in the nick of time and starts fighting it. Sakaki has also arrived in machine 3's carrier with a new set of batteries for Noa. Kanuka needs to hold off the Griffin until Noa can change her batteries.
episodes.title: Viewer Rate 90%

episodes.synopsis: Noa wakes up to discover she has a toothache. But some members of the team think it's more than that, especially when Asuma has been teasing her about her wisdom teeth all morning. The team force Asuma to apologize, but that just makes things worse, especially when there was no apparent reason to apologize. Shinshi gives Noa painkillers to ease the pain, but unfortunately she takes them all at once causing her to sleep most of the morning. Later in the afternoon, Division 2 are suddenly called out to an incident where a stolen Labor is running a muck in a forest. Only problem is that every time Noa takes a step in her Ingram, her tooth hurts like mad.
episodes.title: The Greatest Showdown in History

episodes.synopsis: The children's TV program Together With Mother has finally been axed after 20 years, and is about to begin its final broadcast. Unfortunately, one of the cast members, Kumagoro, a man in a bear suit, has decided to take the rest of cast hostage by grabbing them with a small a Labor. He demands ¥300,000,000 and a helicopter or he'll blow up the cast. To prove his claims, he sets off a car bomb in the parking lot. Division 2 are called in, but the producers of the show seem to want to prolong the situation in order to get higher ratings. Kumagami and Noa enter the studio disguised as waitresses in order to free the hostages, but the plan does not go well. The riot police are called in after Division 2's failure, but Goto thinks they'll just inflame the situation more. However, Goto does have a plan which is so bizarre it might just work.
episodes.title: Black Trinary

episodes.synopsis: After the hot water system (a 40-gallon drum attached to propane tank) at the SV2 literally blows up, Division 2 is forced to go to a bath house to wash themselves. Upon driving to the bath house, they come across a man lying unconscious in the street. He identifies himself as a policeman. He has been tracking down a terrorist who has been responsible for several bombings of businesses with contracts with the Babylon Project.
episodes.title: Game Over

episodes.synopsis: Ota has yet again totaled his Ingram in the line of duty. Sakaki orders the mechanics to fix the labor overnight. Shige tells him that they can't do it and have been working non-stop, and will probably need a night off. Sakaki is sympathetic to their plight and checks up on the sleeping mechanics. However he finds tons and tons of pornographic magazines and videos in their possession. Enraged, he publicly burns the lot and instigates new rules, banning many popular pastimes such as fishing, and leaving very little of a private life. The mechanics are very upset and Shige decides to talk to Sakaki. Before he can get a word out, Sakaki tells him that he may be retiring soon, and that Shige will eventually be head mechanic. Sakaki tells him that he will have to look after the mechanics and discipline them. Shige takes this talk the wrong way, and forms a force to weed out mechanics who break the rules. This causes the mechanics to revolt, but some don't agree and splinter groups form. Kidnappings and beatings of other mechanics begin. Though the ruckus doesn't effect their work, Sakaki must do something to regain control.
episodes.title: Seven Days of Fire

episodes.synopsis: Captain Goto treats all of Division 2 to a break at hot spring. Things seem to be going well until Kumagumi tells Kanuka that she has put away the underwear she left in the change room. Kanuka is quite angry at Kumagami. She finds it an invasion of privacy. This causes both of them to argue with each other. The other members try to stop them from fighting, but it only causes them to argue even more. Division 2 give up trying, so they decide to drink themselves into a stupor and try to forget about it. The arguing only gets worse with more alcohol. Meanwhile Captain Goto escapes and decides to call Shinobu just to get away from them.
episodes.title: Versus

episodes.synopsis: Ota has a strange dream where he kills his team mates who have all become criminals. He wakes up to find himself in Shinshi's house where Hiromi, Asuma, Shinshi, and Shige are dead from gun wounds, and Ota is holding a gun in his hand. He runs screaming from the house, but he soon can't remember who he is. Did he kill all those people? He looks in his wallet and because he has Shinshi's wallet, he believes he's Shinshi. Meanwhile the SV2 search for Ota. Goto believes he has amnesia. They must find him before he hurts someone else or himself.
episodes.title: It`s Called Amnesia

episodes.synopsis: While riding back to the hanger in the rain, Noa spots a cardboard box near the gate. Inside is a small kitten that was abandoned by someone. She sneaks it inside and asks Hiromi to help care for it. He says it's very weak and might die, but Noa is determined to help it survive. Being called out to Labor incidents doesn't really help, so she asks Asuma to talk Shige into helping while their called out to crime scenes. The kitten survives and is doing very well. Unfortunately, it looks like Captain Goto might know, and it's getting harder and harder to keep it under wraps. During cleaning of the hanger, the kitten escapes and nobody can find it. Division 2 are called out to a crime and Noa discovers the kitten sitting in the cockpit of Alphonse. Unfortunately, it wants to play and causes Noa to lose control of her Ingram.
episodes.title: The Day Goma Came in from the Rain

episodes.synopsis: Goto and Shinobu are returning from a conference in Karuizawa. Shinobu has sprained her ankle by falling down the stairs as she left and Goto has had to drive her back. Unfortunately, a typhoon is headed for Tokyo and they end up in the middle of the storm. Every way they turn there are traffic jams and road closures. Shinobu refuses to return to the conference because of the embarrassment of spraining her ankle. There's no way to get back to Tokyo. Instead of waiting it out, Goto suggests they stop over at a motel for the night and drive back the next morning. The only problem is that there is only Love Motels in the area, not normal ones. Feeling a little nervous about the prospect, Shinobu reluctantly agrees to spend the night at one of these places. Goto of course doesn't really care where he spends the night. But could this be Goto's lucky day? This episode explores Goto's unrequited love towards Shinobu and shows that she might feel the same way.
episodes.title: Two in Karuizawa

episodes.synopsis: A urethra stone made of pearl is excreted from the captured albino alligator (now in the Tokyo Zoo) that was found in the labyrinth of tunnels under the reclaimed land beneath the SV2 hanger. With the stone being worth over ¥200,000,000, some of the mechanics try their luck to see if there are anymore albino alligators excreting the stones down there. They don't return and nobody is particularly happy about staging a rescue mission to find them, especially after what happened last time. Sakaki wants to seal the manhole up, but Asuma decides to help and ropes in most of Division 2 to help him. Meanwhile Matsui calls Gotoh to tell him Tadayama Fumihiro, the man who lived down there and occasionally stole food from the SV2, has escaped the mental institution he was in and is most likely headed back to the underground passages. This information comes a little to late for the team and they fall prey to most of his traps, causing Ota to accidentally shoot up most of their equipment. Will they ever get out of there alive?
episodes.title: The Dungeon Again

episodes.synopsis:
Asuma discovers a postcard inviting him to a school reunion. However, he doesn't remember receiving it. He goes to the reunion and sees Yuki Kasama, a girl whom he once had a crush on when he was at school. He feels rather embarrassed and doesn't speak to her, but she goes over to talk to him after the reunion. After talking to her, he reluctantly asks her on a date. The next day they go to the museum and planetarium. Asuma has to go to the toilet but when he returns to his seat Yuki has gone. In the seat where she sat there is a postcard from an exhibition of photographs. Rather confused, he goes to the exhibition the following day and meets Yuki, who is looking at the photographs. She apologizes for leaving and they both sign the guest book. While walking her out, she mysteriously disappears again.

The following day at a crime scene, Noa is about to fire upon a criminal labor. Suddenly Asuma sees Yuki standing behind the labor and orders Noa not to shoot. Noa eventually stops the labor, but his team mates are confused at his actions. They could not see anybody behind the labor. Later that night, Yuki comes to the SV2 hanger to apologize for actions that day. She tells him that she will be leaving the country and she'll never see him again. She runs out, but Asuma can't catch up with her. The next day, he finds the invitation to the school reunion again, but the date is the following day. At the reunion, he asks about Yuki. His old school friends tell him that she hasn't been seen in years and no one could get in contact with her. Asuma goes to the exhibition and cannot find his or Yuki's name in the guest book. Did she actually meet him or is it all just a dream?
episodes.title: Snow Rondo

episodes.synopsis: Noa has had a very hard day. She comes back to the hanger and heads straight for bed. She wakes in the middle of the night and notices a light on in a small building at the back of the hanger. She investigates, but can find no one inside. She places her hand on a poster on the wall, and a portal opens below her feet. She ends up in some sort of underground base, and finds the whole of the SV2 down there in strange uniforms.  into Ingraman, a giant alien from the AV-98 Nebula who defends Earth.
episodes.title: The Girl Who Came from the Stars

episodes.synopsis: Division 2 are on vacation. Noa is doing some cleaning at home, but can't find a personal item she had since she was a child. She goes to work but can't find it there either. She meets Kumagami there who is writing up a proposal to create two extra Divisions. Ota is also there, dismantling and cleaning his Labor's gun. Kumagami submits her plan to Captain Goto and Shinobu. He tells her that they are already planning something like this and ask if she would be interested in being captain for the third division. She says that she would have to think it over, which surprises both Goto and Shinobu. The next day Kumagami is taking a trip to see some of the new cadets who will eventually form the third division, and asks everyone to come along. Asuma says he and Noa can't and tells them they have something important to do. Despite her protests, Noa goes along with Asuma.
episodes.title: All Quiet at the Second Unit

episodes.synopsis: Inspector Zenigata has been removed from the Lupin case which leaves him despondent, and he ends up drinking with Lupin & Jigen. Lupin decides that he and his gang should work with Zenigata to solve his new case, investigating a group of arms dealers known as Shot Shell. Lupin gathers his partners together (Jigen, Goemon, & Fujiko), and with Zenegata they steal a Russian submarine. They kidnap a scientist named Karen Korinsky to help them operate the sub, and also to protect her from Shot Shell. Meanwhile the ICPO assigns a man named Keith Hayden to the Lupin case, and unlike Zenigata he wants Lupin and his group dead. Where ever Lupin and friends go, Keith follows, as the officer attempts to pick them off one by one.

info.synopsis: L'ispettore Zenigata viene esonerato dall'incarico di catturare Lupin perchè non ne è ritenuto all'altezza. Viene assunta quindi una nuova ispettrice di nome Keith, intenzionata a catturarlo, non importa se vivo o morto. Il celebre ladro, infastidito da quest'insolita siuazione, vuole far tornare Zazà alle sue vecchie mansioni, approfittando di un nuovo caso riguardante il traffico di armi da parte di un'organizzazione chiamata Shot Shell. Con l'aiuto di Jigen, porta a termine il furto di un sottomarino russo per poi venderlo all'organizzazione. Per guidare il sottomarino occorre necessariamente una mano esperta, quindi chi meglio della sua stessa creatrice? Rapiscono così l'astrofisica russa, mente del progetto, e le fanno pilotare il sottomarino. In seguito, John Cloths, il capo della Shot Shell, incontra Lupin, che assume come suo dipendente. Ma il ladro è intenzionato soltanto a mettere le mani sul suo denaro, cosa che lo stesso Cloths sospetta da tempo. Ma cosa più importante: riuscirà a ridare a Zenigata il suo vecchio incarico, senza essere catturato dall'agguerrita agente?
info.title: Lupin III - Viaggio nel pericolo (ITA)

episodes.synopsis:
Usagi Tsukino è una normale ragazza giapponese che frequenta la seconda media, piagnucolosa e un po' goffa, come lei stessa ammette, la cui vita subisce un cambiamento radicale il giorno in cui incontra una gatta parlante di nome Luna. Questa le spiega che lei è destinata a diventare una delle Guerriere Sailor paladine della giustizia, per salvare il mondo dalle forze del male e al contempo trovare le sue compagne e la Princess.

La sua prima missione risulta esser quella di aiutare la sua migliore amica Naru Osaka, e sua madre proprietaria di un negozio di gioielleria; impara così ad utilizzare i suoi nuovi poteri per combattere i nemici in battaglia, che vogliono impossessarsi dell'energia (energia vitale nell'adattamento italiano) degli esseri umani. Ma ecco che nel momento di maggior difficoltà viene salvata dal misterioso Tuxedo Kamen abbigliato in smoking e cilindro, di cui immediatamente s'innamora.
episodes.title: Una guerriera speciale

episodes.synopsis:
La Queen Beryl del Dark Kingdom manda il suo servitore Jadeite sulla Terra a raccogliere l'energia degli esseri umani, questo per poter risvegliare dal suo sonno la grande Queen Metaria. Questi tramite un negozio di cartomanzia attira ed inganna un gran numero di persone desiderose di andar a farsi legger la mano e conoscer il proprio futuro, e mediante l'uso della carta del diavolo li rende servitori del male e ad essi ordina di esaudire ogni loro desiderio

Dopo aver osservato lo strano comportamento di alcuni dei suoi amici, tra cui Umino Gurio, che vi si sono recati, Usagi si rende conto che sta succedendo qualcosa di strano e si reca, col supporto di Luna, ad indagare.
episodes.title: Vedo e prevedo

episodes.synopsis:
Ora Jadeite raccoglie l'energia umana attraverso una spilla a forma di fiore, la flower brooch, che viene consegnata in regalo per posta a coloro le cui lettere d'amore vengono scelte per esser lette al programma Midnight Zero ("Mezzanotte lettere d'amore in diretta" nell'adattamento italiano) dalla stazione radio FM no.10; una delle prime vittime è la professoressa d'inglese di Usagi, Haruna Sakurada, e poi la stessa Naru. Luna scopre il pericolo e convince Usagi ad indagare

Trasformatasi grazie alla "penna magica", la penna del cambiamento (penna lunare nell'adattamento italiano) in una conduttrice radiofonica e riesce ad entrare nella stazione radio: dopo essersi trasformata in Sailor Moon si troverà a dover combattere contro Jadeite; per fortuna proprio nel momento in cui si trova più in pericolo compare Tuxedo Kamen ad aiutarla come al solito.
episodes.title: Lettere d'amore

episodes.synopsis:
Usagi è ingrassata di qualche chilo e gli è venuta l'ossessione del peso. Jadeite apre una palestra (palestra con salone di bellezza nell'adattamento italiano), la Shapely (Beauty Gym nell'adattamento italiano), che si occupa principalmente di far perdere peso in brevissimo tempo; in realtà si tratta d'una trappola appositamente escogitata per attrarre le persone in speciali capsule e rubargli in tal modo l'energia mediante i raggi Shape (raggi rinvigorenti nell'adattamento italiano).

Usagi e gle sue amiche decidono di entrar in questa palestra attirate dalla prova gratuita e per vedere come ha fatto la loro insegnante a perder molto di peso in un giorno solo; Usagi dopo esser fuggita, scoraggiata dalla troppa fatica, tornerò successivamente, pentita, con Luna insieme a Luna e quest'ultima, vedendo la Professoressa Haruna molto debilitata la segue e scopre le capsule. Convinta Usagi a seguirla, e a trasformarsi in Sailor Moon, si confrontano con Jadeite, il quale però stavolta riesce a fuggire dopo aver fatto raccolto una grande quantità d'energia umana, lasciando però Sailor Moon lottare contro gli allenatori della palestra da lui controllati. Gli allenatori controllati mediante un diadema attaccano Sailor Moon che, convinta da una possibile perdita di peso reagisce, e grazie alla tiara distrugge i diademi e libera i malcapitati.
episodes.title: Cura dimagrante

episodes.synopsis: Usagi tries to convince her parents to let her adopt Luna, but her brother Shingo has a great disliking of Luna and slight ailurophobia. Later, a mysterious new pet store opens in town which is selling strange new creatures that put Shingo and everyone else who gets one into a hypnotic trance.
episodes.title: Profumo di trappola

episodes.synopsis: Usagi befriends Yusuke Amade, a jazz musician who is being followed by a Youma, and helps him confess to the woman he loves.
episodes.title: Musica e amore

episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Naru both dream of becoming stars like Mikan Shiritori, a graduate from their school. When the girls hear that Mikan is holding a talent contest, they see their chance to achieve stardom.
episodes.title: La strada del successo

episodes.synopsis: The Sailor Guardians go to the Dream Land amusement park, where visitors have reportedly gone missing. The team splits into two groups: Usagi and Rei and Ami and Luna. But, much to Rei's frustration, Usagi is more focused on playing than finding the missing people.
episodes.title: Un mostro...ma di bravura

episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Ami go to the city to enjoy some shopping, where they find a clock store selling a clock that resembles Luna. Later that day, Usagi is happy to learn that her mother bought the exact same clock as a gift. But that night, the clocks from the store emit a strange light, making Usagi and the rest of Tokyo very impatient.
episodes.title: Una lotta contro il tempo

episodes.synopsis: Several people who take the bus near the Hikawa Shrine have gone missing. Usagi, Ami, and Luna decide to investigate by visiting the shrine. There, they meet Rei Hino, a shrine maiden with strong spiritual powers.
episodes.title: Il mistero dell'autobus scomparso

episodes.synopsis: Queen Beryl is increasingly furious with Jadeite for his repeated failures; he starts up a theme park, but the general public notices the large number of disappearances. Usagi and Rei, who is now Sailor Mars, begin their combative friendship.
episodes.title: Il parco dei divertimenti

episodes.synopsis: One of Queen Beryl's youma offers to help Jadeite with his wicked plans. Rei wins tickets on a luxury cruise ship and, since she has no boyfriend, asks Ami to accompany her. A jealous Usagi sneaks aboard after them.
episodes.title: Una romantica crociera

episodes.synopsis: Usagi continues to be attracted to both Motoki and Tuxedo Mask. Threatened with Eternal Sleep if he should fail again, Jadeite confronts the Sailor Guardians at an airport.
episodes.title: La fine di Jack

episodes.synopsis: Nephrite is appointed as Jadeite's successor and begins selecting individual targets for energy, the first one being Naru's friend Rui.
episodes.title: Un nuovo nemico per Sailor Moon

episodes.synopsis: Rei falls for Mamoru and persuades him to go on a date with her, whilst Nephrite targets the caretaker of a local park.
episodes.title: Pericolo al parco

episodes.synopsis: Usagi decides to enter a homemade wedding dress contest, while her home economics teacher is targeted by Nephrite.
episodes.title: Fiori d'arancio

episodes.synopsis: Nephrite targets a gifted young photographer, while Usagi tries to achieve her dream of becoming a model.
episodes.title: Tutti in posa

episodes.synopsis: Shingo upsets his friend Mika, an award-winning doll maker whose skills make her the next target for Nephrite's energy gathering.
episodes.title: Sam e le bambole

episodes.synopsis: Nephrite takes advantage of Sailor Moon's attraction to Tuxedo Mask by sending love letters to Usagi and her classmates. Naru falls in love with him in his civilian disguise, allowing him to drain a large amount of her energy.
episodes.title: Cara Sailor Moon

episodes.synopsis: Usagi, Ami, Rei, and Luna take a vacation in order to train, but the hotel they have booked is haunted by a strange phenomenon.
episodes.title: Il fantasma

episodes.synopsis: Nephrite uses his most powerful Youma to target an animator working for the new Sailor V movie.
episodes.title: Cartoni animati in pericolo

episodes.synopsis: Both Luna and Queen Beryl wonder if a visiting princess could be the one the Sailor Senshi has been looking for. Mamoru dreams he is Tuxedo Mask and a girl is asking him for the Silver Crystal. At the ball, Usagi gets her first kiss.
episodes.title: Una festa movimentata

episodes.synopsis: Zoisite decides to use Nephrite's recently discovered romantic feelings for Naru to manipulate him into handing over the Black Crystal to him.
episodes.title: Un amore impossibile

episodes.synopsis: Still in love with Nephrite, Naru becomes an unwilling tool in the power struggle between Nephrite and Zoisite.
episodes.title: Addio Nevius

episodes.synopsis: Queen Beryl partially awakens the evil entity Metalia and sends Zoisite and Kunzite to find the Seven Great Youma and their Rainbow Crystals. Meanwhile, the tomboyish Makoto Kino transfers into Usagi's school and falls for a crane-game whiz at the arcade.
episodes.title: Sailor Jupiter

episodes.synopsis: Naru is still very depressed after Nephrite's death. Usagi and Umino decide to take her to Yokohama to cheer her up. There, a kindly priest is attacked by Zoisite. Mamoru realizes that he is Tuxedo Mask, and drops a locket on the ground, where Usagi finds it.
episodes.title: La forza dell'amicizia

episodes.synopsis: Ami meets Ryo Urawa, a clairvoyant boy who has a crush on her. However, Urawa's power makes him aware that he will soon be transformed into a Youma by Zoisite.
episodes.title: Un ammiratore di Amy

episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Mamoru are asked to model for the reclusive painter Yumemi Yumeno, who is unexpectedly targeted by Zoisite.
episodes.title: Disegni d'amore

episodes.synopsis: Makoto, like Usagi, develops a crush on Motoki. The two then decide to pursue him simultaneously, even after finding out that he has a girlfriend, who, meanwhile, is targeted by Zoisite and Kunzite.
episodes.title: La ragazza di Moran

episodes.synopsis: After fighting off an attack by Zoisite, Rei's grandfather takes on an apprentice and begins acting strangely.
episodes.title: Un mostro inatteso

episodes.synopsis: Luna discovers that she has an admirer, in the form of an overweight tomcat named Rhett Butler. Meanwhile, the Sailor Guardians and Zoisite compete for the last Rainbow Crystal.
episodes.title: Un fidanzato per Luna

episodes.synopsis: Umino misinterprets Usagi's advice on seducing Naru, and begins to adopt the persona of Tuxedo Mask.
episodes.title: Terrore al Luna Park

episodes.synopsis: Zoisite disguises himself as Sailor Moon to lure Tuxedo Mask and the Sailor Guardians out into the open. The Dark Kingdom injures Tuxedo Mask's identity, but they are foiled by the appearance of Sailor Venus.
episodes.title: La quinta guerriera Sailor

episodes.synopsis: Mamoru is forced to confront Zoisite in a duel over the Rainbow Crystals, but Usagi inadvertently becomes involved.
episodes.title: La Principessa della Luna

episodes.synopsis: Usagi and Mamoru remember their former lives as Princess Serenity and Prince Endymion. The Dark Kingdom kidnaps the injured Mamoru, but Queen Beryl executes Zoisite for his attempt to kill him. Luna and Artemis tell the Sailor Guardians about their tragic past.
episodes.title: Il Regno della Luna

episodes.synopsis: Minako tries to cheer Usagi up by taking her to a hair salon, leading to the discovery that Tuxedo Mask is still alive, but now very different.
episodes.title: Un nemico inaspettato

episodes.synopsis: Determined to become more like the princess she is supposed to be, Usagi decides to enlist in Countess Rose's Princess Seminar.
episodes.title: Lezioni di bon ton

episodes.synopsis: Usagi and her friends visit the Moonlight Course skiing resort, unaware that Kunzite has sabotaged the Moon Princess Contest in order to unmask Sailor Moon.
episodes.title: Avventura sulla neve

episodes.synopsis: After discovering that the Moon Princess was once known for her graceful ice skating, Kunzite tries to use this information to trap Sailor Moon. The best skater among the girls, however, turns out to be Makoto. Tuxedo Mask appears to help them, but only because he does not agree with Kunzite's method of involving bystanders.
episodes.title: Lezione di pattinaggio

episodes.synopsis: Usagi and her family visit a hot springs resort, while Endymion is sent to resurrect an ancient legendary monster.
episodes.title: Lo spirito del lago

episodes.synopsis: Queen Beryl orders the seven people gathered who had carried Rainbow Crystals, intending to combine them into one huge youma. Ami is determined to protect Urawa. Sailor Moon tries to heal Endymion.
episodes.title: Il ritorno dei sette malvagi

episodes.synopsis: Kunzite probes Sailor V's connection with the Sailor Senshi by targeting Katarina, an old acquaintance of Minako's.
episodes.title: Un triste ricordo

episodes.synopsis: On orders from Queen Beryl, Kunzite and his Youma investigate the rumors of a rift between Sailor Moon and the other Inner Sailor Guardians, who seem to want both the mystical Moon Stick and the Silver Crystal for themselves.
episodes.title: Litigio fasullo

episodes.synopsis: A blast of energy sends the Guardians to the ruined Moon Kingdom, where they meet a hologram of Queen Serenity and learn about their past. Luna and Artemis find the entrance to the Dark Kingdom. Kunzite attacks, but is finally defeated by Sailor Moon.
episodes.title: Un viaggio nel tempo

episodes.synopsis: After defeating Kunzite, regaining their past memories, and discovering the Dark Kingdom's hideout the Sailor Senshi head for the enemy, but they must prepare for the ultimate sacrifice.
episodes.title: La resa dei conti

episodes.synopsis: With her friends killed, Sailor Moon is transported inside the Dark Kingdom to face Queen Beryl and the brainwashed Prince Endymion.
episodes.title: La vittoria delle guerriere Sailor

info.synopsis: Siamo in Giappone, all’inizio degli anni Novanta. Usagi Tsukino è una normalissima ragazza che frequenta la seconda media all’istituto Juuban. Una mattina Usagi incontra una gattina nera con un cerotto sulla fronte; la ragazza, presa la gattina, le toglie il cerotto, ma la gattina la graffia e scappa via. Usagi, arrivata in classe in ritardo, viene rimproverata dalla professoressa Aruna, che si lamenta con lei anche del suo scarso rendimento scolastico. Uscita da scuola Usagi, depressa per il risultato del compito in classe e avendo paura di mostrarlo alla madre, accartoccia il foglio e lo getta via. Il foglio cade in testa ad un affascinante ragazzo che non appena visto il voto prende in giro la giovane. Usagi infuriata gli strappa il foglio di mano e allontanandosi gli dice di farsi i fatti propri. Tornata a casa Usagi viene rimproverata anche da sua madre per il voto disastroso che ha preso nel compito in classe, appena 30/100. Salita in camera propria Usagi si stende esausta sul letto ma proprio in quel momento la gattina nera entra dalla finestra presentandosi come Luna e annunciandole di averla scelta per combattere i nemici del Dark Kingdom, guidati dalla perfida Queen Beryl che insieme ai suoi quattro generali ha intenzione di invadere la terra e rubare agli uomini l’energia vitale che le occorre per risvegliare Queen Metallia, che giace addormentata da secoli.

episodes.synopsis: Chirico Cuvie demands answers when his unit opens fires on their forces during a top-secret mission, but his superior officer stonewalls him. What is going on?
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Months after the mission that changed his life forever, Chirico hides in the wretched hive known as Uoodo. What recourse does he have when he is enslaved by a local gang?
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Chirico has plans for the ruined Scopedog he found in the junkyard. Will this be the opportunity he needs to turn his luck around?
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Recognizing Chirico's expertise as a pilot, Gotho offers him an opportunity to make his fortune in the underground VOTOMS gladiatorial sport known as Battling.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Chirico is caught by powerful people who believe the soldier was sent to Uoodo under orders. As they torture him for information, Chirico's allies plan a rescue mission.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Reflecting upon the events thus far, Chirico leaves to face the chief of police. His allies plan a daring heist without him.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Rumors swirl of the police using a city-wide sweep as cover for a mysterious transport. Intrigued, Chirico investigates.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: The crew celebrates, but Chirico wishes no part in the spoils. While the police react, another player watches from the shadows.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Chirico faces the wrath of the police alone. Enraged, Coconna demands that the crew return to help their friend.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: The police adopt a scorched earth policy in their attempts to flush Chirico and his allies out. Forced to run, the four take drastic measures to save their own lives.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: The Prototype defies a direct order to engage Chirico in combat. The police chief and Borough attempt to discover why while the AT pilot dominates the battle.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Chirico and the Prototype are discussing their situation when the police discover their location. Borough proposes that Battling pilots chase after them.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

episodes.synopsis: The military occupies Uoodo and demands the surrender of police forces. Chief Iskui is ordered by his superior to buy time so the Prototype can be smuggled out of the city.
episodes.title: Episodio 13

episodes.synopsis: Three months after the events on Uoodo, a new chapter unfolds as Chirico finds himself on the front lines as a mercenary in the war-torn kingdom of Kummen.
episodes.title: Episodio 14

episodes.synopsis: Captain Kan Yu's assistance arrives just in time and Chirico is questioned for his battlefield decision. A PS is a deadly opponent, so what are their options when facing one?
episodes.title: Episodio 15

episodes.synopsis: The mercenaries fend off a guerrilla raid, but Pol is shocked when he recognizes one of the attackers. Chirico discovers Pol's connection to the Kummen army.
episodes.title: Episodio 16

episodes.synopsis: Chirico miscalculated, and the enemy was not who he thought it was. Despite this, he's still determined to find answers, and the two soldiers clash.
episodes.title: Episodio 17

episodes.synopsis: Chirico's been found, but his miraculous survival causes the suspicious Captain Kan Yu to accuse him of switching sides and demands his interrogation.
episodes.title: Episodio 18

episodes.synopsis: A Melkian officer plans to inspect the front lines when the Veela unleash their assault on EX-10 and Niitan. Vanilla refuses to abandon the club despite Coconna's urging.
episodes.title: Episodio 19

episodes.synopsis: Chirico reflects upon his previous adventure and the events that led to his reunion with Fyana in Uoodo.
episodes.title: Episodio 20

episodes.synopsis: Chirico is put in charge of an operation against enemy headquarters. Kan Yu objects, believing he should be in command instead.
episodes.title: Episodio 21

episodes.synopsis: Kan Yu is criticized for his actions and ordered to follow a new strategy as everyone's plans seemingly depend on Chirico.
episodes.title: Episodio 22

episodes.synopsis: Fyana seizes an opportunity and flees into the jungle. An injured Borough is enraged when he realizes that Ypsilon has gone after her and orders the unthinkable.
episodes.title: Episodio 23

episodes.synopsis: Loyalties are tested after Chirico rewards his friends with the truth after they save both him and Fyana from an ambush.
episodes.title: Episodio 24

episodes.synopsis: A man left for dead refuses to die, despite everything the jungle throws at him. Meanwhile, Chirico's group plans their assault.
episodes.title: Episodio 25

episodes.synopsis: Vanilla must join a massive assault, despite Gotho and Coconna's concerns. With the forces converging on the palace, is the war finally coming to an end?
episodes.title: Episodio 26

episodes.synopsis: Three figures muse over the status of the war as fighting rages on the planet below. Chirico confronts Borough and demands answers regarding the PS.
episodes.title: Episodio 27

episodes.synopsis: Before the next adventure begins, Chirico recalls painful memories of his past exploits in Uoodo.
episodes.title: Episodio 28

episodes.synopsis: Chirico and Fyana may have escaped Kummen, but they now find themselves in an undisclosed and seemingly abandoned location. For what purpose are they there?
episodes.title: Episodio 29

episodes.synopsis: Chirico and Fyana attempt to thwart their attackers, but they are too numerous. Does the enemy have good reasons for its actions?
episodes.title: Episodio 30

episodes.synopsis: The captain is done playing and vows to capture Chirico and Fyana. A distraction is all it takes for Chirico's AT to suffer critical damage.
episodes.title: Episodio 31

episodes.synopsis: Chirico's condition deteriorates, and Fyana must take drastic measures if she wishes to save him.
episodes.title: Episodio 32

episodes.synopsis: Chirico and Fyana fight at a disadvantage against Ypsilon. How will they turn the tide when Ypsilon's hatred for Chirico drives him to a single-minded purpose?
episodes.title: Episodio 33

episodes.synopsis: A brawl with a scavenger gang leads to a reunion with an old friend. Meanwhile, a captain must decide whether to continue a mission or pursue Chirico.
episodes.title: Episodio 34

episodes.synopsis: The ATs stare each other down in grim anticipation of the coming battle. When the Balarant suddenly attack, everyone must scramble for their lives.
episodes.title: Episodio 35

episodes.synopsis: The trio is alone in the desert and low on oxygen. Zophie has not forgotten, nor has she forgiven. But to survive, she may need Chirico's assistance regardless.
episodes.title: Episodio 36

episodes.synopsis: Repairs on the AT continue, but the Balarant forces are quickly approaching. Chirico wants his friends to save themselves, but they have other plans.
episodes.title: Episodio 37

episodes.synopsis: Ypsilon and Chirico are destined to fight over and over. But when they are both trapped by debris, can Ypsilon set aside his hatred in the interest of mutual survival?
episodes.title: Episodio 38

episodes.synopsis: With the immediate danger behind them, Chirico and Ypsilon prepare for their sworn rematch. Will they finally be able to settle things once and for all?
episodes.title: Episodio 39

episodes.synopsis: Time is a flat circle. Chirico remembers how he escaped from Kummen alongside Fyana, only to end up on a mysterious warship.
episodes.title: Episodio 40

episodes.synopsis: With his ship crashed, Chirico has no choice but to venture into the hostile deserts of Quent if he wishes to continue his mission.
episodes.title: Episodio 41

episodes.synopsis: The Society no longer underestimates Chirico and considers him a legitimate threat. Meanwhile, Chirico and Shako must brave the desert on their travels.
episodes.title: Episodio 42

episodes.synopsis: The twins decide to make planetfall. Meanwhile, Chirico requests entrance to the Quentman village.
episodes.title: Episodio 43

episodes.synopsis: There can be no more room for doubt in the Society's mind: Quent contains a trove of advanced technology. What will be their next move after this discovery?
episodes.title: Episodio 44

episodes.synopsis: The events on Quent captures the attention of another party, which deploys its forces in response. Chirico and Shako explore the ruins beneath the planet's surface.
episodes.title: Episodio 45

episodes.synopsis: As Gilgamesh and Balarant forces prepare for battle, the Society wonders how they can use this to their advantage. Unless something changes, Quent will turn into a warzone.
episodes.title: Episodio 46

episodes.synopsis: The battle rages over the planet. To the victor goes Quent's secrets. Chirico's friends escape in a stolen Gilgamesh ship but are quickly intercepted by the Balarant.
episodes.title: Episodio 47

episodes.synopsis: Onboard a ship not under their control, its passengers can only wait as it ventures closer to an object that is clearly no moon. What awaits all of them inside?
episodes.title: Episodio 48

episodes.synopsis: A 3,000-year-old truth unites the warring Gilgamesh and Balarant into a single, vengeful army. Meanwhile, what are the implications for Wiseman's plans with Chirico?
episodes.title: Episodio 49

episodes.synopsis: A failed mutiny solidifies Chirico's control. The joint Gilgamesh/Balarant fleet devises ways to fight Wiseman. As forces converge, a question burns: How can one stop a god?
episodes.title: Episodio 50

episodes.synopsis: History is filled with men who sacrificed everything in pursuit of power. Fyana refuses to let her love be one of them. Is Chirico truly willing to make everyone his enemy?
episodes.title: Episodio 51

episodes.synopsis: The road was long and hard-fought but in the end, a choice will be made. That choice will determine the fate of the entire galaxy.
episodes.title: Episodio 52
